blocks.text: Network load balancing is used to manage network traffic. It distributes work among multiple servers or links. This helps prevent overloading of one device. Load balancing improves network speed and reliability. It is used in large networks and data centers. Proper load balancing ensures smooth performance. It helps networks handle more users.

Load balancing improves network speed and response time. It reduces the risk of server failure. If one server fails, others continue working. It provides better user experience. Load balancing helps handle high traffic easily. It increases network reliability and availability.

There are different methods of load balancing. Round Robin method sends requests one by one. Least Connection method sends traffic to less busy servers. IP Hash method uses IP address to decide traffic. These methods balance the network load. Simple methods are easy to implement.
